concrete_inputs_outputs: Implement the four-slot HDPool. Admit11..14, reject15 without taking ownership; close one handle and reuse its same fd with a new generation. Replaying the old readable event and old close must be STALE with unchanged outputs. Exercise generationUINT32_MAX retirement, duplicate live fd, unverified flags and READ/WRITE/HUP/ERROR interest masks. The supplied local socketpair adapter sets/verifies flags and uses dup2 only on its just-released owned descriptor to demonstrate actual integer reuse.
